verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk or account-wide data export or offboarding feature. The note that API responses are JSON is only a developer building block for building an export yourself, not an export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
